error.description: Stable snake_case code the UI translates

paidFrom.title: STAGE or PETTY_CASH for the PM and Admins; Team Leads' expenses are OUT_OF_POCKET. Ignored on a correction.

stageId.title: Required when the destination is STAGE.

actualEnd.title: YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future nor before the stage started.

weight.title: Percentage of the stage, e.g. "25" or "12.5".

pendingCount.title: Waiting for the PM, or for an Admin above the limit.

toReimburseCount.title: Approved, not paid back yet: what the project owes its Team Leads.

executed.title: Basis points of the budget spent (can pass 10000).

funded.title: Basis points of the budget received (can pass 10000).

nextStage.title: Where its leftover goes when completed; null when completed or last.

executed.title: Basis points of the budget spent.

amount.title: Major units, signed: negative when the account gives money.
Major units, signed: what it put into (+) or took out of (−) the caja menor.

description.title: Its note (an expense's description, who was paid back).

id.title: null for a cycle that opens with the next use of the caja menor

closingBalance.title: Snapshot when closed; the running balance while open.

unsignedCount.title: Closed cycles waiting for an Admin's sign-off.

impersonator.title: Set while a super admin is viewing the app as this user.

canImpersonate.title: Shows the "Ver como" menu: a super admin, or someone being viewed as (to offer the way back).

edit.title: Stages, lines, milestones and contingency can be edited (the budget is a draft or was returned).

manageCategories.title: Categories can be added and renamed (also after approval).

review.title: The Admin may approve or return it (it is submitted).

track.title: Stages can be started and milestones met (the budget is approved).

overdue.title: Not met and its planned date has gone by

total.title: Major units: quantity × unit price, rounded half up

milestoneWeightTotal.title: Basis points: must be 10000 to submit

budgetTotal.title: Major units; null for Team Leads

weight.title: Share of the budget in basis points; null for Team Leads

total.title: Major units budgeted in the category

progress.title: Project progress: stages weighted by their share of the budget

issues.title: What blocks submitting, while editable; null for Team Leads

myRole.title: The signed-in user's role here: ADMIN (global), PROJECT_MANAGER or TEAM_LEAD

teamLeadExpenseLimit.title: Major units; a Team Lead expense above it also needs an Admin's approval

pettyCashLowBalancePercent.title: Caja menor alert when the balance drops below this % of the last top-up

budgetWarningPercents.title: Budget alert thresholds, % of a stage or category budget, ascending
